description.value: A well-established Kelowna outdoor sports shop with a strong cycling department covering road, gravel, mountain, and electric bikes. Offers professional bike service, fitting, and rentals alongside a full range of cycling parts and accessories. Also serves runners, skiers, and snowboarders year-round.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: lockers (secure) at 98m; lockers (secure) at 99m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Fresh Air is a full bike shop in Kelowna offering Bike Service & Assessment, Bike Fitting, and Bike Rentals as listed services. The product menu explicitly includes touring-relevant items (Bags & Panniers, Tubes, Road Tires, Tools, Lights & Safety, Locks). A recent blog post from April 2026 confirms the business is active. OSM name 'Fresh Air Concept' differs from the website branding which consistently uses 'Fresh Air'.
